premise.claim: On main, a RoleBasedGroup written through workloads.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1 with spec.coordination never gets any workloads: the v1alpha1 conversion stores the coordination as the conversion.workloads.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1-coordination annotation, and EnsureV1alpha1CoordinatedPolicy server-side-applies a CoordinatedPolicy whose spec.policies[] entries carry no name, so the apply is rejected (.spec.policies: element 0: associative list with keys has an element that omits all key fields ["name"]) and the reconcile returns before step 8 creates any role workload. (issue #517, quoted)
premise.evidence: results/base-verify-specs.out — harness grafted onto merge-base 8a7bcfcb: the exact #517 SSA error repeats as 'Reconciler error' and the contract spec times out waiting for the CoordinatedPolicy (no policy, no RoleInstanceSet).
match: contract: names every applied policy so the apply is accepted and workloads appear
